text: This solution, Government‑Led Efforts to Increase Earthquake Insurance Penetration in China (2020–2025) addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in People’s Republic of China between PICC Property & Casualty, Government of China, World Bank, Munich Re, Swiss Re, AIR Worldwide, RMS, and EQECAT. The program was implemented in 2020 and focuses on collaboration and regulation.
